CustomField.label: Shipment Key
CustomField.description: The pair key: the 18-character shipment Id, a colon and the hex SHA-256 of the typed postal code normalized (83 characters), unique, so the guard is written by upsert on it and a pair never has two guard rows (hardening-1 S1, SEC-002).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shipment Id and a hash of the typed postal code; one guard per pair.
